topic: 数据比较与图表描述入门
grammarFocus: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词。
title: Comparing Data at a Community Library
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先阅读题目，听第一遍时抓住大意，听第二遍时记录关键信息。选择题请选出一个最佳答案；填空题答案必须与录音原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解析均为中文，并附有原文证据。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Thanks for helping me with the library survey report. I've got the numbers from last year and this year, but I'm not sure how to describe them.
Ben: No problem. Let's look at the visitor numbers first. So, last year the library had 8,000 visitors, and this year it had 10,000. That's an increase of 2,000.
Mia: Right. And the number of books borrowed? Last year it was 15,000, and this year it's 18,000.
Ben: So that's a rise of 3,000. That's a 20 percent increase, isn't it? Wait, no. 3,000 divided by 15,000 is 0.2, so yes, 20 percent. Good.
Mia: OK. What about the number of events? Last year there were 40 events, and this year there were 50. So there was an increase of 10 events.
Ben: Yes, and attendance at events? Last year 600 people came, and this year 900. That's a big jump.
Mia: It is. Now, the number of computers. Last year there were 20 computers, but this year there are only 15. So the number decreased.
Ben: That's a decrease of 5 computers. And the number of staff? Last year there were 8 staff members, and this year there are 10. So there was an increase of 2.
Mia: Right. And the opening hours? Last year the library was open 50 hours a week, and this year it's open 55 hours. So that's an increase of 5 hours.
Ben: OK. Now, what about the satisfaction survey? Last year 70 percent of visitors were satisfied, and this year 85 percent were satisfied. So satisfaction went up by 15 percent.
Mia: Wait, is that 15 percent or 15 percentage points? I always get confused.
Ben: Good question. It's 15 percentage points. The percentage went from 70 to 85, so that's a 15 percentage point increase. But if you say 'increased by 15 percent', that's not quite right because 15 percent of 70 is 10.5, so it would be 80.5 percent. So we should say 'increased by 15 percentage points'.
Mia: OK, I'll write that. And the number of new members? Last year there were 200 new members, and this year there were 250. So there was an increase of 50.
Ben: Yes. So overall, most numbers went up, but the number of computers went down. That's interesting.
Mia: It is. I think we have enough data now. Thanks, Ben!

questions.prompt: How many visitors did the library have this year?
questions.explanation: 录音中Ben说：“this year it had 10,000”，因此今年访客数为10,000。

questions.prompt: What was the increase in the number of books borrowed?
questions.explanation: Ben说：“that's a rise of 3,000”，所以借书量增加了3,000。

questions.prompt: How many events were there last year?
questions.explanation: Mia说：“Last year there were 40 events”，因此去年活动数量为40。

questions.prompt: What happened to the number of computers?
questions.explanation: Mia说：“this year there are only 15. So the number decreased.” 电脑数量从20台减少到15台，因此是减少了。
questions.evidence: this year there are only 15. So the number decreased.

questions.prompt: How many staff members were there last year?
questions.explanation: Ben说：“Last year there were 8 staff members”，所以去年有8名员工。
questions.evidence: Last year there were 8 staff members

questions.prompt: What was the increase in opening hours per week?
questions.explanation: Mia说：“this year it's open 55 hours. So that's an increase of 5 hours.” 开放时间从50小时增加到55小时，增加了5小时。
questions.evidence: this year it's open 55 hours. So that's an increase of 5 hours.

questions.prompt: How did Ben describe the change in satisfaction?
questions.explanation: Ben纠正说：“It's 15 percentage points.” 并解释从70%到85%是增加了15个百分点，而不是15%。

questions.prompt: How many new members were there this year?
questions.explanation: Mia说：“this year there were 250”，所以今年新会员为250人。

questions.prompt: Last year, the library had ______ visitors. (Write a number.)
questions.explanation: Ben说：“last year the library had 8,000 visitors”，因此去年访客数为8,000。
questions.evidence: last year the library had 8,000 visitors

questions.prompt: Attendance at events increased from 600 to ______ people. (Write a number.)
questions.explanation: Ben说：“this year 900”，活动出席人数从600增加到900。

vocabulary.meaning: 百分点（用于比较百分比的变化）

vocabulary.example: Last year 70 percent of visitors were satisfied.
Thanks for helping me with the library survey report.

grammar.title: 比较结构与趋势表达
grammar.explanation: 在描述数据变化时，我们常用“there was/were + 名词 + 增加/减少”的结构，例如“there was an increase of 10 events”。比较百分比时要注意“percent”和“percentage points”的区别：从70%到85%是增加了15个百分点，而不是15%。趋势动词如increase, decrease, rise, go up, go down等可以帮助我们描述变化。
grammar.example: there was an increase of 10 events

questions.prompt: Last year there were 30 students in the class, and this year there are 36. What is the increase?
questions.explanation: 36减去30等于6，所以增加了6名学生。
questions.evidence: Last year there were 30 students in the class, and this year there are 36.

questions.prompt: The price of a ticket went from $20 to $25. How would you describe this change?
options: There was an increase of 25 percent.
There was a decrease of 20 percent.
questions.explanation: 价格从20美元涨到25美元，增加了5美元。
questions.evidence: The price of a ticket went from $20 to $25.

questions.prompt: In 2010, 40% of people used bicycles. In 2020, 60% used bicycles. What is the change?
questions.explanation: 从40%到60%是增加了20个百分点，而不是20%。
questions.evidence: In 2010, 40% of people used bicycles. In 2020, 60% used bicycles.

questions.prompt: There ______ 12 cars in the parking lot last year, but now there are 15. (Use was or were.)
questions.evidence: There were 12 cars in the parking lot last year.
